title: Steve Austin vs. Mr. McMahon
summary: An unruly champion refuses the boss’s demands. Arrests, corporate challengers and direct confrontations turn their struggle for control into an Attitude Era centerpiece.

chapters.title: Austin stuns McMahon
chapters.result: Austin delivers a Stunner to McMahon and is arrested.
chapters.context: A direct attack on authority supplies an early defining moment.

chapters.title: Dude Love challenges Austin
chapters.result: Austin retains the WWF title in a disqualification loss to Dude Love.
chapters.context: McMahon’s effort to control the champion expands through a challenger.

chapters.title: McMahon wins the Royal Rumble
chapters.result: McMahon last eliminates Austin to win the Rumble.
chapters.context: The boss takes the match Austin had been favored to dominate.
